diff --git a/app/hours.py b/app/hours.py
index bbe5487..3a70bd9 100644
--- a/app/hours.py
+++ b/app/hours.py
@@ -2,4 +2,6 @@ from datetime import time
 
 
 def is_open(now: time, opens: time, closes: time) -> bool:
+    if closes < opens:
+        return now >= opens or now < closes
     return opens <= now < closes
diff --git a/tests/test_hours.py b/tests/test_hours.py
index eae7b76..b5b3fce 100644
--- a/tests/test_hours.py
+++ b/tests/test_hours.py
@@ -9,3 +9,21 @@ def test_open_during_the_day():
 
 def test_closed_from_closing_time():
     assert not is_open(time(18), time(9), time(18))
+
+
+def test_open_late_in_the_evening():
+    assert is_open(time(23, 30), time(18), time(2))
+
+
+def test_open_after_midnight():
+    assert is_open(time(1), time(18), time(2))
+
+
+def test_closed_in_the_morning():
+    assert not is_open(time(10), time(18), time(2))
+    assert not is_open(time(2), time(18), time(2))
+
+
+def test_closed_when_opening_and_closing_at_the_same_time():
+    assert not is_open(time(9), time(9), time(9))
+    assert not is_open(time(12), time(9), time(9))

# Review rules

- Never log a secret: an API key, a token or a password.
- Amounts are integer cents, never floating-point numbers.
- A query takes its values as parameters, never built into the SQL text.
